dataset.title: EEA Discodata IED ProductionFacility fixed schema v1r2

related_catalogue_release.title: Industrial Emissions Directive 2010/75/EU and European Pollutant Release and Transfer Register Regulation (EC) No 166/2006 - ver. 16.0 Feb. 2026 (Tabular data)

query_parameters.query: SELECT countryCode, reportingYear, streetName, buildingNumber, city, postalCode FROM [IED].[v1r2].[ProductionFacility] WHERE countryCode = 'DE' AND reportingYear = 2024 AND addressConfidentiality IS NULL AND facilityNameConfidentiality IS NULL AND parentCompanyConfidentiality IS NULL AND streetName IS NOT NULL AND LEN(streetName) > 0 AND buildingNumber IS NOT NULL AND LEN(buildingNumber) > 0 AND city IS NOT NULL AND LEN(city) > 0 AND postalCode LIKE '[0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9][0-9]' ORDER BY streetName, buildingNumber, city, postalCode

api.request_encoding: application/x-www-form-urlencoded query string; percent-encode the SQL query value

license.basis: The frozen EEA legal notice applies CC-BY to EEA-held website materials unless a different condition is stated; the related Industrial Reporting metadata independently states CC BY 4.0 and EEA copyright.
license.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International

naming_compatibility: The additive filename/schema family was allocated while version-16 package equivalence was still being tested. It is retained for path stability only; the canonical source is fixed Discodata v1r2 and exact equivalence to the related v16 ACCDB package is explicitly not asserted.

safe_field_policy.source_values_not_acquired: all source-row identifiers; coordinates and geometry; facility, parent-company and site names; activities, status, contacts, URLs, NUTS/RBD fields, benchmark data, competitor data and every other source column

transformation: Outcome-blind Germany-only normalized address extraction from all 10,470 frozen rows. The server-side query retains only rows with all three ProductionFacility confidentiality fields null, exact country DE, reporting year 2024, non-empty street/building/locality and exactly five decimal postcode characters. Read and normalize only the six selected fields; never use coordinates or source identifiers. Reject placeholder, conflicting, incomplete, range-ambiguous or parser-ambiguous address projections fail closed.

version_binding.catalogue_witness: The frozen current Discodata metadata catalogue contains ProductionFacility under both latest and v1r2 with the same 36-column schema. The six selected-field multisets from latest and the canonical fixed v1r2 acquisition are equal at 10,470 rows.
version_binding.mutable_alias_policy: latest is retained only as an equivalence witness and is not the canonical frozen source.
version_binding.v16_package_equivalence: not_asserted; proving it would require a 2,031,214,592-byte ACCDB acquisition solely for provenance comparison, which is not justified for this bounded development experiment

warning: The wider API exposes confidential, identifying and coordinate fields outside the overlay scope. The frozen canonical response contains exactly the six allowlisted fields and no identifiers or coordinates; do not infer or reacquire excluded values.
